name: pds-marketplace

owner.name: Faculty of Electrical Engineering, University of Banja Luka

description: AI assistant plugins of the PDS course (Projektovanje digitalnih sistema): student plugins that teach the course workflow, and instructor plugins that only the course staff can install.

plugins.name: pds-course
plugins.description: Course workflow of PDS: setup check, task context, pull request description, failed CI checks and time tracking. Teaches the workflow, never runs it.

plugins.name: pds-design
plugins.description: Design review for the PDS course: VHDL style rules explained, synthesis warnings (latches, sensitivity lists), resources and timing from Quartus reports, DE1-SoC pin mapping and board testing.

plugins.name: pds-git
plugins.description: Git coach for the PDS course: branch from an issue, commit messages in the course format, push and sync, merge conflicts, fixing mistakes. Shows and explains every command; the student runs it.

plugins.name: pds-learning
plugins.description: Learning companion for the PDS course built on the course material: topic pages of the 15 video lectures with video moments, verified example code (runnable with GHDL), notes on errors in the videos, glossary (Serbian and English) and self-check questions. Hints and explanations, no solutions of graded tasks.

plugins.name: pds-testing
plugins.description: Testbenches for the PDS course: self-checking patterns, test vector tables, procedures, file-based tests, clock and reset, running them exactly like the course CI with GHDL (VHDL-2008) and reading the results.

plugins.name: pds-template
plugins.description: PDS course staff only: course templates and syncing course repositories.

plugins.name: pds-admin
plugins.description: PDS course staff only: course repository setup, issues, sprints and progress.

plugins.name: pds-assignments
plugins.description: PDS course staff only: preparing assignment texts.

plugins.name: pds-verification
plugins.description: PDS course staff only: tests of the verification environment.

plugins.name: pds-review
plugins.description: PDS course staff only: reviewing submissions.

plugins.name: pds-materials
plugins.description: PDS course staff only: teaching materials and topic pages.
